build_llvm_opt_command: build an LlvmCommandLine action space to serialize LLVM pass actions into an opt command line string
parse_llvm_opt_command: parse an LLVM opt command line string and deserialize it back into a list of actions
test_LlvmCommandLine_to_string: test the LlvmCommandLine to_string method to verify it generates correct opt command line invocations
test_LlvmCommandLine_from_string: test the LlvmCommandLine from_string method to verify it correctly parses opt command line strings into actions
review_LlvmCommandLine_class: review the LlvmCommandLine class to understand how it wraps an ActionSpace for LLVM opt serialization and deserialization
